initialBuild.reason: The parent was concurrently integrating required isolated product AI images; morphosphere-ultramarine-pansy-pierced had no registered detail image yet. No map error was reported. No retry until parent stable build.

browser.scope: Two stores (Hamamatsuya and Hakone Maruyama) × JA/EN × 1440/320 fresh Chrome contexts, plus an untrusted-provider rejection case. This is eight real iframe displays, not a claim of live browser inspection of all 23 shops.
results: Before action: no Google iframe and zero Google requests in all eight cases.
Keyboard Enter on the explicit button displays the selected Google map with Google attribution and Terms visible.
Nominal desktop320×230 produces a318×228 iframe inside its2px border; at320page width the iframe is248×208 inside nominal210height. No horizontal page overflow.
Close removes the iframe; Maps choice does not change this origin localStorage or sessionStorage keys.
Reload starts off and produces zero Google requests.
Official links show meaningful names; ordinary store/Maps external fallback links remain available.
An injected provider on www.google.com.evil.test is rejected after action, with fallback still visible.

visualInspection.method: Viewed four private viewport screenshots directly after the run.
observations: Live road maps and the intended store labels were visible, with complete Google logo, ©2026 Google and Terms/利用規約 within the frame.
Small right-column desktop map and full card-width mobile map remain legible.
Hamamatsuya intentionally keeps the original maker-published Japanese-language Google embed in both site languages; the site buttons, store content and Privacy link localize.

initialBrowserAttempt.reason: The first test expected exact iframe dimensions of 320×230 / mobile210, but the nominal viewport includes a 2px border, making actual iframe dimensions 318×228 / mobile248×208. Four cases failed at that test expectation after live Google map and attribution had loaded. The run was interrupted; no UI/runtime/data change was made.
initialBrowserAttempt.resolution: Test-only allowance of ±2px and removal of an unnecessary await, authorized by the parent. All checks then reran in fresh Chrome contexts.
